chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: It is not permissible for the one praying to pray with one prayer unless he has already performed it.
So if he prays it a second time before having prayed it (properly/completed it), he must repeat it.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on praying a specific obligatory prayer twice in succession?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq’s (a) ruling on the validity of repeating a specific prayer (such as Fajr) if the first instance was defective, emphasizing that the second performance is only valid if the first was not yet completed or was invalid. This highlights the Shia jurisprudential principle of *ta'arud* (conflict) in prayer timing and the necessity of ensuring the obligatory act is fulfilled correctly before undertaking a new one. The hadith underscores the precision required in *salat* to avoid redundancy or invalidation due to improper sequencing.
